title: Chapter 635 - 635 Fight; Unbelievable!
content:
Chapter 635 - 635 Fight; Unbelievable!

Chapter 635 - 635 Fight; Unbelievable!

635 Fight; Unbelievable!

Fang Wenjie first mentioned his identity.

Then, he used what he thought was a clever method to push all the responsibility to the hotel and to Lin Fan!

He believed that the Imperial Hotel would definitely make the best choice.

In fact, Fang Wenjie was already imagining the scene of Lin Fan being captured and then being brutally beaten up by him.

Gradually, a cruel smile appeared on Fang Wenjie’s face.

…

However, Fang Wenjie’s words had a completely different effect to the people present.

Offering twice the price to buy the dishes Lin Fan had ordered?!

Also, he wanted to use 100,000 World Coins to get Lin Fan’s private room?!

The Fang family? Dafang Group?

What guts!

Wang You, Wang Qianjin, Wang Zhihai, and the other family heads of the Wang family all had extremely ugly expressions.

Wang Zhihai, who was wearing a white training suit, said coldly, “Explanation? You deserve a beating!”

As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Zhihai took a step forward. He was seemingly slow but actually fast.

In the blink of an eye, he arrived in front of Fang Wenjie and kicked twice.

Fang Wenjie’s legs broke with a crisp sound.

At the same time, a blood-curdling scream echoed on the 365th floor of the Imperial Hotel.

…

In the live broadcast room.

Fallen Leaves: [Did he make a move?]

Forget: [That’s the young master of Dafang Group. From the looks of it… his legs are broken?]

Shura: [This old man seems to be the grandfather of the current general manager of the Imperial Hotel, Wang You. He’s actually a powerful special ability user.]

Everyone’s Hobbies: [Not only was the young master of the Dafang Group beaten up at the Imperial Hotel, but his legs were also broken by the old master of the Wang family. Now, the Fang family and the Wang family are in trouble.]

Song Ren: [Old Master Wang actually beat up Fang Wenjie because of that young man. Who exactly is that young man?]

…

Countless comments kept rolling.

Everyone was shocked.

…

Wang Zhihai was completely unaware of the situation in the live broadcast room.

He used his indifferent eyes to glance at the gorgeous woman standing beside Fang Wenjia. She was so frightened that her face instantly turned pale and she fell to the ground weakly. Cold sweat rolled down her face as her entire body trembled.

It was terrifying.

Wang Zhihai did not attack her. Instead, he turned around and walked back. He bowed and continued to speak in an extremely respectful tone, “Mr. Lin, I’m sorry to disturb you.”

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “It’s fine. It’s just the barking of a mad dog. Just throw him out.”

“Yes,” Wang Zhihai said.

Under the watchful eyes of everyone in the live broadcast room, several members of the Wang family dragged Fang Wenjie, who was still screaming miserably, into the elevator by his limbs.

The 365th floor of the Imperial Hotel quickly quieted down.

“Is our food almost ready?” Lin Fan asked as if nothing had happened.

Wang Zhihai did not say anything and turned to look at the waiter beside him.

The waiter was already shocked by what had happened in front of him.

After a while, he noticed Wang Zhihai’s gaze and hurriedly said, “It should be done soon. I’ll help you urge the chefs.”

As he spoke, he quickly walked to the side and picked up his phone to make a call.

After a while, three chefs quickly walked over with fresh ingredients.

Very soon, the colorful and fragrant delicacies were served on the table one after another.

Lin Fan took a whiff of the fragrance and nodded. “It looks pretty good.”

Then, he said to Xia Xue, “Xia Xue, try it.”

“Ah… Alright, alright,” Xia Xue stuttered.

She slowly picked up her chopsticks and put the red meat into her mouth.

Soon, Xia Xue’s beautiful eyes lit up as she sincerely praised, “Delicious!”

Lin Fan looked at how happy she was and was extremely happy as well.

He picked up a piece of meat and golden sea urchin.

“This tastes good too.”

Xia Xue ate the sea urchin as well.

The two of them ate for nearly an hour, and their stomachs became round.

At this time, the sky was gradually darkening. Through the floor-to-ceiling windows, one could easily take in the night view of Jiangbei.

After eating and drinking to their fill, they looked at the beautiful scenery. It was truly a great enjoyment.

When Lin Fan pushed open the door, Wang Zhihai, Wang Qianjin, Wang You, and the other core members of the Wang family were all waiting outside like loyal servants.

When they saw Lin Fan, they bowed and greeted him respectfully.

Lin Fan nodded. “Help me prepare a room. I’m going to take a shower and rest.”

Strictly speaking, it had been over a thousand years since Lin Fan had bathed and slept in a bed.

His body was not dirty.

Sleeping was just a method to get rid of the waste in the human body and recover the human body’s skills,

And with Lin Fan’s physique, he did not even need to sleep to achieve those things.

However, Lin Fan still wanted to take a shower and sleep on the bed.

It was the experience that mattered.

Then, Lin Fan asked, “Xia Xue, do you want to stay here together?”

Xia Xue’s pretty face flushed as she stuttered, “I… I still have something to do back at school, so I won’t be staying.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Okay, send Xia Xue to Jiangbei University.”

“Yes,” Wang Haizhi said excitedly.

Excited?

That was right!

Excitement!

To Wang Zhi Hai, being able to do something for Lin Fan was an extremely glorious thing.

This was the Wang family’s ancestral teachings!

When Xia Xue came downstairs to the Imperial Hotel, a super luxury hover car was already waiting at the door.

The waiter opened the door for Xia Xue and said respectfully, “Miss Xia, please.”

Xia Xue was amazed by the appearance of the hover car.

After a while, she came back to her senses and said, “Ah… Alright, alright.”

The exterior was stunning, and the interior was unbelievably luxurious.

It was spacious, with soft and comfortable leather seats, soft lighting, high-end drinks, as well as desserts… It was like a moving castle. How fascinating!

The car sped all the way. Xia Xue did not feel any acceleration, deceleration, or bumps.

When the car door opened again, Xia Xue found that she had appeared in front of the gate of Jiangbei University.

This feeling was as if she had just traveled through space. It was extremely magical.

Xia Xue was stunned for a moment, and then she said to the driver, “Thank you.”

“It’s my honor,” the driver said respectfully.

After the super luxury car drove off, Xia Xue remembered that she was still broadcasting.

She quickly picked up the foldable monitor.

The next moment, she was completely stunned.

In this live broadcast, Xia Xue was completely different from before. Usually, she was always interacting and communicating with her fans. She even showed her talents.

Hence, Xia Xue was already prepared for her popularity to drop after this.

However, at this moment, the number of people online in the live broadcast room had actually reached 2.1 million!

It was simply unbelievable!
